In this section, we will only consider the case where q is a prime p. We remark that a proof of the rate in the case of dx = dy was given in an earlier work [16]. However, in our case, we will need a stronger statement about the nonexistence of monomials above a certain degree in order to prove local testability in Section 5.1, which is given in Lemma 34.
